lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate all remaining probe declarations (tmux, jq, pgrep, ps, bun, uuidgen)

openQuestions: CAM-432 (out of scope for both US-003 and US-004) still needs to delete the now-provably-dead `test.skipIf(!xAvailable)(...)` gates once each binary is confirmed a true hard dependency everywhere in CI; all skipIf call sites were deliberately left untouched by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-004 completed the centralization sweep started in US-003: added 6 new precomputed exports to test-deps.ts (tmuxAvailable, jqAvailable, pgrepAvailable, psAvailable, uuidgenAvailable, bunAvailable -- each `isAvailable(name)`, mirroring gitAvailable from US-003), then migrated all 21 remaining scattered probe-declaration lines across 17 call-site files to pure `import { xAvailable } from '../helpers/test-deps.ts'`. Two multi-var files needed care: test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (tmuxAvailable/pgrepAvailable/uuidgenAvailable combined into one import, `shouldRun` derivation kept as a local const) and test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts (removed the intermediate pgrepCheck/bunCheck spawnSync consts entirely, since only their derived booleans were ever used downstream). test/integration/sendkeys-submit.test.ts's tmuxAvailable was a try/catch-wrapped IIFE around `Bun.spawnSync(["tmux", "-V"])`; replaced wholesale with the import since Bun.which never throws (no try/catch needed). test/release/merge-watch.test.ts had a describe-block-scoped `const jqAvailable` (not module-level) migrated the same way. AC1 and AC2 centralization oracles both now return EMPTY repo-wide (verified). AC14(i-iii) must-survive invariance pins all match main-derived counts exactly: pgrep -f x5, ps -ax x1, tmux -L node-form x14, tmux -L Bun-form x5 -- none of the real ADR-0039-protected wire-boundary driver calls were touched, only the `-V`/`--version` probe declarations. test/run.test.ts and test/stop.test.ts's `tmuxAvailable` DI-fake option-name tokens (object property names, not module-level const/let declarations) were correctly left untouched -- they don't match the AC1 regex and are a different concept entirely (a fake-spawn behavior toggle, not a real probe). Verified live: full-PATH `bun test` = 5702 pass / 0 fail / exit 0 / no skip-summary-line (identical floor to US-003, pure refactor, no tests added/removed); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun run check:all` full spine green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). test/fixtures/version-skip-guard/** untouched (git diff/status both empty). The centralization sweep this PRD (CAM-424) set out to do is now complete for all 7 tracked binaries (git, tmux, jq, pgrep, ps, uuidgen, bun); no further probe-declaration migration work remains under test/**. Only remaining open thread is CAM-432 (delete provably-dead skipIf gates), explicitly out of scope for this PRD.
